name: rm-seller-listing-suspended
subject: Your listing to sell an investment has been cancelled
previewText: Trading of this investment has been suspended

fields.heading:
Your
listing has been cancelled
fields.body:
Hello
{first_name},

Trading
of {pitch_title} on the marketplace has been
temporarily suspended as this investment has an upcoming
return payment. We have therefore had to withdraw your sell
listing from the marketplace.

Once
the investment return has been paid you can re-list your
investment for sale if you wish.

Abundance
Investment Ltd, Hamilton House, Mabledon Place, London, WC1H
9BB

This
email and all attachments transmitted with it are intended
solely for the use of the addressee and may contain legally
privileged and confidential information. If the reader of this
message is not the intended recipient you are hereby notified
that any dissemination, distribution, copying, or other use of
this message or its attachments is strictly prohibited. If you
have received this message in error, please delete it and notify
Abundance immediately.

Nothing
in this message shall be considered an offer to sell, or a
solicitation of an offer to buy, any investment to any person in
any jurisdiction to whom or in which such offer, solicitation or
sale is unlawful. Abundance does not provide legal, financial or
tax advice of any kind, and nothing in this email constitutes
such advice. To the extent permitted by law, Abundance does not
accept any liability arising from the use of this
communication.
